title: PIPphone
description: Modern in-game phone HUD and app menu with CarLib integration for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric.
body:
PIPphone

PIPphone brings a modern in-game phone system to Minecraft!
Designed for immersive gameplay and vehicle integration, this mod adds a sleek phone HUD and app menu directly into your world.

Built with compatibility for CarLib, PIPphone can display live vehicle telemetry and driving information while keeping a clean and stylish interface.

Features
📱 Fully integrated in-game phone UI
🚗 CarLib support and telemetry integration
🖥️ Custom HUD overlay
⚡ Lightweight and optimized
🎮 Designed for immersive roleplay and driving experiences
🔧 Built for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric
Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
CarLib
Compatibility
Minecraft 1.21.1
Java 21+
Why PIPphone?

PIPphone is perfect for players who want a more realistic and interactive Minecraft experience, especially when using vehicle or city-style mods. Whether you're cruising around your world or building a modern roleplay server, PIPphone adds a futuristic touch to gameplay.
